svg.title: One connection from initialize to close_binary
svg.desc: Three lifelines: the capture client re101-capture 1.0.0, rea mcp from rea-agents 6.7.0 over stdio, and Ghidra 12.1.4 headless with a fresh project. Fifteen numbered exchanges: initialize with protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and the reply naming rea 6.7.0 with tools and prompts; tools/list and the reply of 207 tools in 284 ms; open_binary on ledger-arm64-O1 with provider_id ghidra, answered mach-o arm64 in 1,632 ms after the install checks and before any import; list_procedures, which makes rea start the Ghidra import, auto-analysis and bridge under its 330,000 ms deadline, Ghidra reports ready, and the reply lists 13 procedures after 6,349 ms; procedure_assembly for _grade answered with 15 instructions in 4 ms from the session; close_binary, which shuts Ghidra down and deletes the ephemeral project, answered result null in 491 ms.
